Lounge layout, explained for visitors
They often ask us about it
Pet Lounge Access at Aurelia Skyways

The Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps the process calm and practical for travelers and their animals. This guide focuses on what to expect when using the pet lounge, with simple checks that help the visit stay smooth and humane.

The lounge is built for comfort, not fuss. Handlers use gentle methods, keep voices low, and watch each animal for signs of stress. Travelers should keep leashes secure, carriers closed when needed, and paperwork ready before approaching the desk. Good preparation cuts down on confusion and helps staff move things along without crowding.

At Port Isolde, <<FACT F009>>. That rule matters because space and care standards both need to stay consistent, so travelers are asked to arrive prepared and follow staff direction without delay.

Some travelers arrive with a nervous pet and need a slower handoff. That is normal. The desk can help with check-in details, crate guidance, and the best way to settle a cat or dog before boarding. If you are bringing Scout, keep the routine familiar and avoid sudden handling. Familiar blankets, quiet words, and a steady pace can make a real difference.

At Merrowgate, <<FACT F023>>. Travelers passing through there should plan ahead and listen for the lounge opening notice before lining up, since early arrivals can create avoidable stress for animals waiting nearby.

If you are unsure about documents, carrier fit, or the right way to move through the lounge, ask the desk staff before you enter. The team is there to give clear, warm, professional help and to keep each animal safe and calm from start to finish.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
